# SNHU Shapiro Library Frequently Asked Questions

> Comprehensive FAQ resource for Southern New Hampshire University's Shapiro Library covering research methods, database access, citation styles, and academic support.

SNHU Shapiro Library's FAQ platform provides guidance for students on conducting academic research, accessing library resources and databases, evaluating sources, and properly citing materials. The site emphasizes research methodology, peer-reviewed sources, and integration of AI tools in academic work.

## Key Topics

- Shapiro Library
- Academic research
- Peer-reviewed sources
- Boolean searching
- Citation styles (APA, Chicago, MLA)
- IBISWorld
- Source evaluation
- Scholarly articles
- Research methodology
- Database access
- RefWorks
- Primary and secondary sources
- Research gaps
- AI tools in research
- Student services

## Research Fundamentals

- [What is the difference between primary and secondary sources?](https://libanswers.snhu.edu/faq/8666): Explanation of primary and secondary source types for academic research
- [How do I find a scholarly article?](https://libanswers.snhu.edu/faq/8587): Tutorial for searching and locating peer-reviewed scholarly articles
- [I need to find a peer reviewed journal article. Where do I start in the library?](https://libanswers.snhu.edu/faq/87033): Getting started guide for finding peer-reviewed journal articles
- [What is Boolean searching and how can I use it in library databases?](https://libanswers.snhu.edu/faq/8739): Guide to Boolean search techniques for effective database searching
- [Where can I find a qualitative or quantitative study in the library?](https://libanswers.snhu.edu/faq/120548): Guide to finding qualitative and quantitative research studies in databases
- [What is a research gap and how do I find one?](https://libanswers.snhu.edu/faq/264001): Guide to identifying and locating research gaps for academic papers

## Source Evaluation & Citation

- [How can I determine if a journal is peer reviewed?](https://libanswers.snhu.edu/faq/86723): Tutorial for evaluating journal peer-review status and credibility
- [How do I read a scholarly article?](https://libanswers.snhu.edu/faq/342556): Strategies and tips for effectively reading and comprehending scholarly articles
- [How old should or can a source be for my research?](https://libanswers.snhu.edu/faq/215024): Guidance on source currency and age requirements for academic research
- [How do I cite an AI tool used in a database?](https://libanswers.snhu.edu/faq/439962): Instructions for citing AI tools in databases using APA, Chicago, MLA styles

## Database Access & Tools

- [Where can I access, and how do I use, IBISWorld?](https://libanswers.snhu.edu/faq/42781): How-to guide for accessing and using IBISWorld business research database
- [What is Phil, the AI tool in IBISWorld, and how do I use it?](https://libanswers.snhu.edu/faq/439963): Guide to using Phil AI tool within IBISWorld database for research
- [Does the library have Claritas 360 data?](https://libanswers.snhu.edu/faq/420716): FAQ on Claritas 360 data availability in SNHU Library resources
- [What do those icons or images next to library databases and electronic resources mean?](https://libanswers.snhu.edu/faq/8799): Explanation of icons and symbols used in library database interface

## Getting Started & Access

- [How do I get a student ID or a library card?](https://libanswers.snhu.edu/faq/67119): Getting started guide for obtaining SNHU student ID and library card access
- [SNHU Shapiro Library Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) - SNHU Library Frequently Asked Questions](https://libanswers.snhu.edu): SNHU Shapiro Library FAQ homepage with citation styles and research resources

## Specialized Research & Collections

- [How do I find legal dictionaries and encyclopedias in the library?](https://libanswers.snhu.edu/faq/342175): Guide to locating legal reference materials in Shapiro Library collections
- [For MKT-205, how do I conduct research on my target market and develop a persona?](https://libanswers.snhu.edu/faq/383169): Course-specific research guide for MKT-205 market research and buyer personas
- [Does the library have audiobooks I can borrow?](https://libanswers.snhu.edu/faq/212162): FAQ about audiobook availability and borrowing from SNHU Library
